rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the coherence and logical organization of arguments, explanations, or writing.

example.traditional: 呢份報告寫得好有條理。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5

rows.note: This written choice describes orderly, coherent expression, especially when discussing the sequence of ideas or arguments.

example.english: Although the article contains a lot of information, its organization has considerable coherence.
example.traditional: 篇文章資料雖然好多，但編排頗有倫次。
example.jyutping: pin1 man4 zoeng1 zi1 liu2 seoi1 jin4 hou2 do1 daan6 pin1 paai4 po1 jau5 leon4 ci3

rows.note: Use this for the quality of the parts forming one integrated whole rather than for the logical order of an argument.

example.english: This design emphasizes the coherence of the different parts.
example.traditional: 呢個設計重視各部分之間嘅整體性。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 cung4 si6 gok3 bou6 fan6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 zing2 tai2 sing3
